name: TriagePriorityCS
title: WEST-A triage priority
description: Triage priorities (colours) that WEST-A assigns at the emergency department
copyright: WEST-A is developed by Västra Götalandsregionen. This code system is an unofficial representation of its priority levels.

concept.definition: Highest WEST-A priority: the patient has a red warning symptom or the vital parameters give red.
Second-highest WEST-A priority: the patient has an orange warning symptom or the vital parameters give orange.
Third WEST-A priority: the patient has a yellow warning symptom, the vital parameters give yellow, or a need or process sets yellow as the lowest priority.
Lowest WEST-A priority: no warning symptom, vital parameter, need or clinical assessment gives a higher priority.
